text: Tailor Made
Passerby A
Did you see the news? Cynthia's dress at the international show is blowing up online!
Passerby B
Yeah... I heard she'll be wearing a custom-made dress to the charity gala next week. I can't wait to see her whole look...
Everyone's talking about Cynthia these days – she's everywhere...
But hey, if we're talking about who gets to meet Cynthia up close... that'd be me, right?
Cynthia
Alright, it's settled – tonight at Mercy Street in One Han City. Don't you dare stand me up!
Yeah, let's keep it hush-hush, unless you want to be chased around by enthusiastic fans.
...Although I've confirmed the meeting place with Cynthia, this location is surprisingly tricky to find.
Pretty sure it's the third streetlight... then cut through that alley...
This should be the place... but why do I feel like...
Someone is watching me...
Who's there?!
Why don't you come to work as my assistant? It would be a shame to waste your talent. I'll even let you decide your own pay.
You'll get flexible work hours, plenty of holidays, and opportunities to travel around the world with me for photoshoots. Tempting, right?
Are you serious?!
...My, you're a tougher cookie to crack than I expected. What if I double your hourly pay? Still no? Triple, then?
You'll even get paid leave, bonuses, and other benefits. Well?
You're more prepared than I thought!
Hehe, relax. By the way, I love that face you just made.
So, what exactly are we doing here on this street?
Just follow me.
Mercy Orphanage...
Mercy Orphanage
Why are we here?
Basically, I'm looking for some inspiration for my new look.
You've come to an orphanage... for inspiration?
That's right. The purpose of this charity gala is to support orphanages in need of funding, so I'd prefer if my outfit that evening could reflect the theme.
But the concepts my team has come up with are all overly romantic and extravagant, making me look like some kind of princess.
So I thought I'd bring you, someone with uncorrupted taste, to search for inspiration instead of letting them waste all that fabric.
I see...
So that's why you're taking things into your own hands.
Sigh... to be honest, it isn't easy. Between my team's questionable taste and a certain rookie's fashion crimes... yeah.
...Don't move. Your collar only looks good if it's folded like this.
Okay, much better now. Let's go inside.
Director
Sorry to keep you waiting. Both of you are checked in. You're good to go see the kids now.
Miss Cynthia... we're already so grateful that you're raising funds for us at the charity gala. For you to also make time to visit the children personally – it's truly thoughtful of you.
It's nothing. Please lead the way.
Okay, please follow me. The children are really excited about meeting you again!
The mold on the wall is gone, and that flickering light bulb has finally been replaced. Looks like the previous donations have been put to good use.
This isn't your first time here, huh?
Is that so...
You could be more honest...
Momo
Oh, it's Cynthia! Cynthia is here!
Leo
Oh yeah... Cynthia... I haven't seen you in a while...
Really? But I was here just last week. How are you two? Have you been good?
M-Me too... I've taken your advice... I've been eating less candy and more veggies...
Oh! It's the crocodile toy I've always wanted! Thank you, Cynthia!
I love it... Thank you, Cynthia...
I'm glad you like it. Remember to keep your promise, okay?
Hmm... I will too... Cynthia, did you bring a friend with you...?
Nice to meet you!
Hi guys.
Yeah, this is my partner – an outstanding grown-up.
Wow! That's so cool! I want to be Cynthia's partner one day too!
Yeah... it sounds so cool to be her partner...
(Strike a cool pose)
OMG, I've been praised by the kids...
Pfft, that's enough. Go have fun now. And you two be good, alright?
Momo & Leo
Okay!
You're really popular with the kids...
I've never seen you be so gentle before...
Not at all. They were just saying how cool you are. You better be a good example for those kids, you know?
Come on now, what makes you say that? Have I truly been that hard on you?
I suddenly feel the weight of expectations!
I'm going to try my best then!
Perhaps... I guess...
Hehe, it's nice to see you look so motivated.
Sigh... You might be right. I should reflect on this.
Okay, time to get down to business. I'm actually leaning toward a minimalist approach – a simple T-shirt should do the trick.
Suggest something cute
Suggest something truly unconventional
player
Given the nature of the charity gala and that it's for children, I think you should choose something cute.
Something cute, huh...? Interesting, I haven't really tried something like that on the runway before.
You should be fine.
Oh? You seem more confident than me. Care to tell me why?
Of course.
First, your professionalism is beyond doubt.

That you, as a model, can provide professional input to the team proves you're not a puppet just doing whatever you're told. You're someone who thinks deeply about the end result and cares about perfecting every detail.
Well, based on your interactions with the children just now, you're quite good at showing your cute side.

While that flawless, cool, and collected persona works for a superstar, kids are always drawn to a warmer, more approachable big-sister type – and luckily for you, you can flip between the two effortlessly.
Those little ones weren't the least bit afraid of you, were they? They genuinely see you as their sweet big sis. And I know you can channel that same energy on stage when you want to.
You know, I think your pep talk is actually working on me, {var:player_nickname}.
And last but not least...
Oh? What else?
I'd like to see you wearing something cute...!
Pfft! Hahaha–! Wow, you've really got some nerve today.
Good. A model is supposed to meet the audience's expectations – and since you're such a key part of that audience, I'm gonna have to step up my game.
Great!
You can do it! Cynthia!
Okay, now that we've decided on a plan, the real headache begins – finalizing the actual design...
Oh... the design...
Cynthia is right. Even though we've settled on a cute style, figuring out the specific look and then choosing the actual patterns... that'll be quite a challenge.
Hmm... this is so hard. What design should we use?
Oh, it looks like Momo and Leo really liked the crocodile building blocks...
Crocodiles... reptiles... hmm. What if we did a design with, like, a giant monster, shooting lasers out of its eyes, as it crawls up from the sea...?
Definitely not!
Hmm...?
Oh, it's you two. What is it?
We were thinking... Since you always give us gifts... we wanted to give you a gift in return too...
Tada!
The two hurriedly take out a canvas and spread it out in front of Cynthia and me.
In the painting, a panda looks adorable while leisurely chewing bamboo on the sunny grass.
Although the brushwork is a little crude, it gives the painting a childlike cuteness.
You guys...
I saw you had a panda keychain on your bag before! So I thought you would like this!
Well... although we haven't seen a real panda yet... we hope you'll like this...
Hehe... Of course I love it.
I'll cherish this.
Maybe we can use this painting!

If we use this artwork for the design, it will not only perfectly convey that childlike charm, but also reassure everyone that the orphanage is truly devoted to caring for the children, and that all funds are being used properly.
Thank you, Momo, Leo. This is a lovely gift.
Yeah, you helped big time! I'll take you guys to see some real pandas next time.
{var:player_nickname}, time to head back to the studio so we can scan and upload this painting. I'll get you to try it on with me once the T-shirts are ready.
Okie dokie!
No problem!
That's the spirit! Well then, let's get you to work.
Prepare yourself – you might even have to pull all-nighters with me.
You know what? Thinking about it, we've got to go with something really out there to grab everyone's attention!
Something out there, huh...? I can't say I've had much experience with styles like that before...
This is a charity gala, so you must stand out!
If we use a concept that's totally fresh new and unlike anything they've seen, it's bound to be unforgettable and a huge hit!
I hear you, but my gut tells me something isn't quite right with it...
There are certainly many ways to approach this. Do you have a more specific plan in mind?
Hmm... more specific...?
Damn, keep thinking! There's got to be something... that can shock the world!
Got it!
A meteor... crashing down...?

And because of this imminent doom, mankind has to build a satellite defense system... That'll take a fortune, of course, so they'll need a massive public fundraising campaign to get the money. The story writes itself – it's brilliant!
Oh... um, I wasn't expecting quite that much enthusiasm from you... It's a very audacious plan, to say the least.
Hmm... Okay, no time to second-guess this. I'll go contact the team right away. You'll be coming too, of course.
Huh? I get to come with you too?
Yeah, you came up with the idea, so I won't let you bail now. You're stuck seeing this through with me.
That said, this T-shirt was spotted by a famous director who was passing the scene, and it became the inspiration for his next big disaster movie. So at least something good came out of it.
Exactly! We can use an image of a giant mecha firing laser beams across the city! This is the ultimate threat, the kind of crisis that decides the very future of humanity!
Mercy Street, One Han City
She's so stunning... I'd kill to meet Cynthia in person!
Let me check Cynthia's text message again...
Good instincts, though your disguise needs work... Hehe, guess I can trust you to handle the paparazzi for me in the future?
Oh? You actually noticed me? Hehe, that expression on your face right now – are you auditioning for some kind of spy thriller?
No, wait. Let me think about it first...
Cynthia, you're now a big celebrity, remember?
Oh? You mean if someone snaps a picture of us looking like we're on a date, and some outrageous rumors start flying around...? Well, you have nothing to worry about.
Huh?! You and me? Dating?!
Getting startled like that actually did help me relax...
I can't accept that... The gala is meant to raise funds for orphanages, not to be some fancy circus show.
Huh? Rookie? Who?
...Hmm. It's getting better now.
You seem really familiar with this place.

Hmm? Oh, yeah – well, as a model, I'm constantly navigating grown-up nonsense. Figured hanging with kids would be a nice change of pace, help keep things real. Besides, the secret to staying young is keeping a youthful heart, you know?
Yeah! I've been brushing my teeth every day!
Wow, that's really good. You both kept your promise to me. Well, I have a gift for you two. Here you go.
Yes! I will!
Ugh, maybe it's because you're just so good? Sometimes your standards seem... up there?
As for the style... Since this is a charity gala, I want people to focus on the children more than me... Do you have any suggestions?
Art Room, Mercy Orphanage
After all, I'm quite tall and lean more toward a sharp, striking kind of look. Honestly, the last time I wore anything "cute" was probably before I even started modeling...
Hmm, it sounds like you know your stuff. And?
Maybe we can ask your team to think about it again...
Huh? Really? I quite like that idea...
Cynthia! Cynthia!
That's right! Recently, the director has been teaching us to paint, so we want to give this to you!
Oh right! The design!
Huh? Oh right...
You're amazing, {var:player_nickname}! You've got a killer eye for both business and art! It's decided then!
We... Did we manage to help you...?
Yay!
The idea of a meteor crashing to Earth will definitely work!
The concept of an alien invasion will definitely work!
That's it!
Exactly! For the design, picture this: a massive comet, hurtling closer and closer to Earth! We're talking about a cataclysmic crisis, one that holds the very fate of humanity in the balance!
But are you sure it'll be okay? It sounds like something an unreliable non-governmental organization would come up with...
It'll be fine. A moment like this is when you need to take a risk!
Afterwards, I participated in the rehearsal with Cynthia, which turned out to be a complete disaster... In the end, we both gave up on this plan.
An... alien... invasion...?

So, to fight back against these alien invaders, mankind has to form an Earth defense force! Naturally, that'll cost a fortune, so it calls for a massive global fundraising campaign. The whole concept is just perfect, right?
